seo_description: Soaked through the door and straight onto their bed. Waterproof dog beds with coated, wipe-clean outers: a cloth, not a wash cycle. Measure and choose.

intro_html: Soaked through the door, a quick go with the towel, then straight onto their bed. A waterproof dog bed wipes clean instead of going in the wash.
description_html:
A waterproof dog bed is for the walk that ends the same way every time: a soaked dog through the door, a quick go with the towel, and straight onto their bed before you can stop them. On fleece or plush, that means a damp bed, a wash cycle and a day of drying. On a coated outer, it means a damp cloth, and the bed is back in use.

Outer coating or inner liner: two kinds of waterproof dog bed

The beds in this collection deal with mess on the outside. Wasdale's green outer fabric is itself the waterproof layer, and the Crummock Waterproof Nest, Ribble and Derwent have coated, wipe-clean outers, so mud, drool and wet paws stay on the surface and come off with a cloth. That is different from a waterproof inner liner, which sits hidden between a washable cover and the foam to protect the core from accidents. If foam support matters more than a wipe-clean surface, beds such as Coniston, Borrowdale and Scafell have liners inside; you will find them among our orthopaedic dog beds.

Choosing by how they sleep, and where

  • If they sprawl: Wasdale has no raised sides, a filled support layer, leather handles and a non-slip base, at 75 × 55cm or 95 × 75cm.
  • If they curl: the Crummock Waterproof Nest keeps high walls on every side over a cushioned base, at 65 × 45cm, 70 × 55cm or 90 × 70cm. It is a nest, not a firm foam mattress.
  • If they lean, in a crate: Ribble puts bolstered sides into a crate-shaped bed, in four sizes from 70 × 55cm to 105 × 75cm.
  • If it is for the boot or a crate floor: Derwent is a low-profile mat at 60 × 45cm, 75 × 55cm or 90 × 65cm.

Looking after a coated bed

Wipe the outer for everyday marks; Derwent wipes down with a damp cloth and mild soap. Before you machine-wash any removable cover, check the sewn-in label, because detergent and machine washing can affect some waterproof finishes, and do not machine-wash Derwent unless its label expressly permits it. Let everything dry before it goes back down. Our care guide has the full routine. In the car, a bed is a comfort accessory, not a vehicle restraint, so use a proper restraint as well.

Give it a wet season: the 100-night trial

Every bed here comes with the 100-night trial from delivery, and should it not suit them, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund, one trial per household, with damage and other exclusions applying. Standard UK delivery is free on orders over £40.

Waterproof dog bed questions

Is a waterproof dog bed a good idea for a puppy or an older dog?

The Crummock Waterproof Nest is made for curled-up sleepers with muddy hobbies, puppies, and older dogs who have the occasional accident: everyday marks wipe off between proper washes. For a foam bed protected from the inside, choose one with a waterproof liner. If accidents are new for an older dog, mention them to your vet.

Can I machine wash a waterproof dog bed?

Check the label first. Some covers can be washed, but detergent and machine washing can affect waterproof finishes, so wiping is the everyday routine. If you would rather wash than wipe, see our washable dog beds.

Which one works in a crate?

Ribble and Derwent, measured against the inside of the crate base so they lie flat without bunching or blocking the door. Our crate and travel beds include a quilted option too.

Not sure which suits them? The Bed Finder picks one bed from how they sleep.
